name: scMultiSim
simulation_summary: Simulates multi-modal single-cell data with gene expression, chromatin accessibility, RNA velocity and spatial locations while modeling cell identity, gene regulatory networks, cell-cell interactions, chromatin accessibility and technical noise.

conditional_required.usage: Wrapper reads this three-column TSV as scMultiSim's GRN parameter table when grn_source=input_tsv; columns are target gene, regulator gene and signed effect.
Wrapper reads this Newick file as scMultiSim's differentiation tree when tree_preset=input_newick.

compatibility_rules.message: num_genes must be null or greater than 100 when grn_source=builtin_100; scMultiSim ignores smaller values and fails at exactly 100.
num_genes must be null or greater than 1136 when grn_source=builtin_1139; scMultiSim ignores smaller values and fails when it equals the built-in GRN gene count.
num_genes must be null or greater than the number of unique genes in regulatory_network when grn_source=input_tsv.

upstream_configuration: tree_preset=auto resolves to Phyla1 for scrna_global; population_mode=auto resolves to continuous.
When dynamic_grn.enabled=false, scMultiSim runs with a static GRN effect matrix; when dynamic_grn.enabled=true, scMultiSim emits cell_specific_grn and the wrapper aggregates it globally.
truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper converts non-zero entries of .grn$geff into context=global when dynamic_grn is disabled, or aggregates cell_specific_grn matrices across all cells when dynamic_grn is enabled.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: Static runs use score=abs(effect) and sign=sign(effect); dynamic runs use score=mean(abs(effect)) across cells and sign from mean signed effect.
limitations: Global truth is wrapper-derived from scMultiSim GRN effect structures rather than emitted as a canonical upstream truth file.
Dynamic global truth summarizes changing cell-specific networks and opposing signed effects can yield ambiguous signs.

truth_contexts.explanation: The global profile does not request or export group truth contexts.
The global profile does not request or export cell-specific truth contexts.

Observed scRNA-seq counts produced by add_expr_noise when technical_noise.enabled is true.
native_outputs.message: observed_counts requires technical_noise.enabled=true because it is produced by scMultiSim::add_expr_noise.

native_outputs.description: Per-cell gene-by-TF GRN effect matrices emitted when dynamic_grn.enabled is true.
native_outputs.message: cell_specific_grn requires dynamic_grn.enabled=true because it is emitted from upstream dynamic.GRN.

derivations.method: Export every generated expression gene identifier from the selected expression matrix as the background gene universe, one identifier per line.
assumptions: The generated expression feature set is the appropriate enrichment background universe for downstream analyses on the simulated dataset.
limitations: The background is dataset-derived, not an external organism-specific gene universe.

derivations.method: Use results$cell_time when do_velocity is true; otherwise use cell_meta$depth when present; if neither exists, derive a deterministic tree-depth coordinate for each cell population and min-max scale the coordinate to [0, 1].
assumptions: scMultiSim cell_time is the native pseudotime at which cell counts were generated.
For non-velocity continuous simulations, cell_meta$depth is a usable trajectory coordinate.
limitations: Discrete populations without cell_time receive one tree-depth coordinate per population.
Branching trajectories are represented as a scalar pseudotime coordinate.

derivations.method: Convert the non-zero entries of the scMultiSim gene-by-TF GRN effect matrix into regulator-target edges with score abs(effect) and sign from sign(effect).
assumptions: The scMultiSim GRN effect matrix is the authoritative simulator regulatory input and can serve as an oracle prior when requested.
limitations: This is a truth-derived oracle prior, not a noisy external prior.

derivations.method: Export the regulator identifiers stored in results$.grn$regulators, mapped back to public gene names, one identifier per line.
assumptions: scMultiSim .grn$regulators is the authoritative TF/regulator list for the simulated GRN.
limitations: The exported TF list reflects the simulated GRN regulators, not an external organism-specific TF catalogue.

derivations.method: When dynamic_grn.enabled is false, convert non-zero entries of .grn$geff into the global truth network. When dynamic_grn.enabled is true, aggregate cell_specific_grn matrices across all cells, use mean(abs(effect)) as score, and derive sign from the mean signed effect.
assumptions: Static simulations have one simulator GRN effect matrix for the whole dataset.
Dynamic simulations are best represented globally by aggregating cell-specific GRN effects over all generated cells.
limitations: Dynamic global truth is a wrapper-derived summary of changing cell-specific networks.
Opposing signed effects across cells can yield an ambiguous global sign.

scrna_global.notes: The global profile exports the whole simulated single-cell expression matrix without groups. The wrapper will use the profile-aware tree_preset=auto rule to prefer Phyla1 for this profile unless a tree is explicitly selected.

dynamic_grn.enabled=true is required because grouped truth depends on scMultiSim cell_specific_grn.
truth_contexts.generation: For grouped runs, the wrapper aggregates cell_specific_grn matrices across all cells and writes the result as context=global.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: score is mean(abs(effect)) across cells; sign is derived from the mean signed effect.
limitations: Global truth for dynamic grouped runs is a wrapper-derived summary of cell-specific GRN matrices.
Opposing signed effects across cells can yield an ambiguous global sign.

upstream_configuration: tree_preset=auto resolves to Phyla5 for scrna_grouped; population_mode=auto resolves to continuous.
dynamic_grn.enabled=true is required so scMultiSim emits cell_specific_grn.
truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper exports groups from cell_meta$pop, aggregates cell_specific_grn matrices over cells in each group, and writes active edges as context=group:<group_id>.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: score is mean(abs(effect)) across cells in the group; sign is derived from the mean signed effect; edges are retained when mean(abs(effect)) is greater than zero.
limitations: Group truth is an ANDREA-derived summary, not a native scMultiSim object.
Continuous populations produce branch or trajectory-segment labels rather than curated biological clusters.
Opposing signed effects within a group can yield an ambiguous sign.

derivations.method: Export each cell's scMultiSim cell_meta$pop value as its group label. Group identifiers are normalized to stable strings while preserving the upstream population identity.
assumptions: scMultiSim cell_meta$pop is the native population or trajectory-segment label for each generated cell.
limitations: Continuous populations produce branch/trajectory-segment labels rather than terminal discrete clusters.

derivations.method: Reuse each cell's group label as its phenotype and assign phenotype order by mean pseudotime/tree-depth coordinate, breaking ties by group identifier.
assumptions: For scMultiSim grouped benchmarks, population labels are appropriate phenotype/state labels.
limitations: Branching structures are summarized by a scalar order.

derivations.method: Export one row per group, using the normalized group identifier as cluster and annotation, and assign order by mean pseudotime/tree-depth coordinate.
assumptions: scMultiSim population identifiers are meaningful synthetic cluster annotations.
limitations: Annotations are simulator state identifiers, not curated biological labels.

derivations.method: Export every generated expression gene identifier from the selected expression matrix as the background gene universe, one identifier per line.

derivations.method: Derive parent-child relationships between exported groups from the selected scMultiSim differentiation tree. For each child-parent pair, aggregate active group-specific GRN edges from cell_specific_grn and report gain/loss rates between parent and child active-edge sets. Exported root groups are included as child rows with parent '__root__' and zero gain/loss rates so lineage_tree.tsv covers every group.
assumptions: The differentiation tree defines the lineage topology for scMultiSim populations.
Group-level active regulatory edges can be summarized from cell-specific GRN matrices.
limitations: The lineage_tree.tsv file is a wrapper-derived summary, not a native scMultiSim file.
Gain/loss rates depend on the active-edge threshold used for group network derivation.
Discrete terminal populations may require collapsing internal tree nodes to exported groups.

scrna_cell_specific.notes: Cell-specific scRNA truth is generated from scMultiSim's native `cell_specific_grn` matrices when dynamic_grn.enabled=true. Cumulative global and group truth are derived from the same native cell-specific matrices, with groups derived from cell_meta$pop.

grn_source.description: GRN source passed to sim_true_counts as the GRN option. Built-in presets use scMultiSim GRN_params_100 or GRN_params_1139; input_tsv uses the regulatory_network simulator input.

tree_preset.description: Differentiation tree passed to sim_true_counts as the tree option. auto uses Phyla1 for scrna_global and Phyla5 for scrna_grouped and scrna_cell_specific.

population_mode.description: Maps to upstream discrete.cif. auto uses continuous for every supported profile unless explicitly overridden.

num_cells.description: Total number of cells to simulate, mapped to num.cells.

speed_up.description: Maps to upstream speed.up, the experimental speed and memory optimization option.

num_genes.description: Optional total number of genes. When null, scMultiSim derives the number from the supplied GRN and unregulated_gene_ratio.

unregulated_gene_ratio.description: Ratio of extra unregulated genes added relative to the GRN genes.

grn_effect.description: Overall strength of the GRN effect on expression, mapped to grn.effect.

num_cifs.description: Number of Cell Identity Factors for each kinetic parameter, mapped to num.cifs.

diff_cif_fraction.description: Fraction of CIFs that encode cell type or trajectory information.

cif_sigma.description: Standard deviation of CIF values; larger values produce noisier trajectories or clusters.

use_impulse.description: Use the impulse model when generating continuous CIFs.

discrete_population.description: Serializable subset of discrete population settings used when population_mode is discrete.

pop_size.description: Optional explicit cell counts for each discrete population. Empty array preserves upstream discrete.pop.size default.

min_pop_size.description: Size of the smallest discrete cell population.

min_pop_index.description: Index of the smallest discrete cell population.

giv.description: Parameters used to sample Gene Identity Vectors.

mean.description: Mean of Gene Identity Vector values.

prob.description: Probability of non-zero Gene Identity Vector values.

sd.description: Standard deviation of Gene Identity Vector values.

high_expression.description: Settings for randomly selected highly expressed genes.

range.description: Only genes with ID greater than this value are eligible for high-expression scaling.

proportion.description: Proportion of genes selected as highly expressed.

mean.description: Mean multiplier for highly expressed genes.

sd.description: Standard deviation of the high-expression multiplier.

max_var.description: Genes with higher variation are not selected as highly expressed genes.

atac.description: scATAC-related settings that also influence scRNA expression through chromatin accessibility.

effect.description: Influence of chromatin accessibility on gene expression.

region_distrib.description: Probabilities that a gene is regulated by zero, one or two consecutive regions; values must sum to one.

p_zero.description: Proportion of zeros in simulated scATAC-seq data.

riv_mean.description: Mean of Region Identity Vector values.

riv_prob.description: Probability of non-zero Region Identity Vector values.

riv_sd.description: Standard deviation of Region Identity Vector values.

rna_model.description: RNA simulation settings controlling kinetic variation and intrinsic noise.

vary.description: Which kinetic parameters vary across cells.

bimod.description: Controls bimodality of the gene expression distribution.

scale_s.description: Scale of the s parameter. A scalar maps directly to upstream scale.s; an array can specify per-cluster values for discrete populations.

intrinsic_noise.description: Weight assigned to random Beta-Poisson sampling in the RNA model.

velocity.description: Full kinetic model and RNA velocity settings. The wrapper default enables this so pseudotime and velocity truth are available.

beta.description: Splicing rate for the kinetic model.

d.description: Degradation rate for the kinetic model.

num_cycles.description: Number of cycles run before sampling gene expression.

cycle_len.description: Multiplier for cell-cycle length in velocity mode.

dynamic_grn.description: Dynamic GRN settings. enabled=true maps to a dynamic.GRN list so scMultiSim emits cell_specific_grn.

num_steps.description: Number of steps in each dynamic GRN epoch.

cell_per_step.description: How many cells share the GRN at the same dynamic GRN step.

items.description: Gene identifier allowed to participate in new dynamic GRN edges.

involved_genes.description: Genes within which new edges may be created. Empty array preserves the upstream default of all existing GRN genes.

num_changing_edges.description: If less than one, proportion of edges changed per epoch; otherwise number of edges changed per epoch. The wrapper rejects values that resolve to exactly one changed edge because scMultiSim 1.8.0 drops matrix dimensions in dynamic.GRN$restructure() for single-edge updates.

create_tf_edges.description: Whether new dynamic GRN edges may connect two TFs.

weight_mean.description: Mean effect of newly created edges. Null preserves the upstream rule of using the mean input GRN effect.

weight_sd.description: Standard deviation of newly created edge effects.

technical_noise.description: Optional add_expr_noise settings. When enabled, expression.tsv is written from observed counts unless batch effects are also enabled.

enabled.description: Whether to run scMultiSim add_expr_noise after sim_true_counts.

alpha_mean.description: Mean capture efficiency for observed-count simulation.

n_pcr1.description: Number of PCR cycles in the pre-amplification step.

n_pcr2.description: Number of PCR cycles after fragmentation.

atac_obs_prob.description: Observation probability used when adding ATAC technical noise.

batch_effect.description: Optional divide_batches settings. Requires technical_noise.enabled=true because upstream divide_batches operates on observed counts.

enabled.description: Whether to run scMultiSim divide_batches after add_expr_noise.

mod_cif_giv_preset.description: Preset for upstream mod.cif.giv, which expects an R function. Only none is currently serializable and supported.

ext_cif_giv_preset.description: Preset for upstream ext.cif.giv, which expects an R function. Only none is currently serializable and supported.
